description: This file implements a WhatsApp Cloud API client that handles WebRTC call connections, webhook verification, and call event processing. It manages ongoing calls, establishes WebRTC connections, and interacts with the WhatsApp API to answer or terminate calls.

classes.name: WhatsAppClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with WhatsApp Cloud API, managing WebRTC connections, and handling call events via webhooks.

methods.name: None __init__( self, whatsapp_token: str, phone_number_id: str, session: aiohttp.ClientSession, ice_servers: Optional[List[IceServer]] = None, whatsapp_secret: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the WhatsApp API client with required tokens, session, and ICE servers.

methods.name: update_ice_servers(self, ice_servers: Optional[List[IceServer]] = None)
methods.description: Updates the ICE server list for WebRTC connections.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_secret(self, whatsapp_secret: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp webhook verification secret.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_token(self, whatsapp_token: str)
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp API access token.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_phone_number_id(self, phone_number_id: str)
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp phone number ID.

methods.name: None terminate_all_calls(self)
methods.description: Terminates all ongoing WhatsApp calls by sending API requests and disconnecting WebRTC connections.

methods.name: int handle_verify_webhook_request( self, params: Dict[str, str], expected_verification_token: str )
methods.description: Verifies the webhook verification token and challenge from WhatsApp.

methods.name: _validate_whatsapp_webhook_request(self, raw_body: bytes, sha256_signature: str)
methods.description: Validates the HMAC SHA-256 signature of the webhook request body.

methods.name: bool handle_webhook_request( self, request: WhatsAppWebhookRequest, connection_callback: Optional[Callable[[SmallWebRTCConnection], Awaitable[None]]] = None, raw_body: Optional[bytes] = None, sha256_signature: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Processes incoming webhook requests for call connect and terminate events, establishing or cleaning up WebRTC connections accordingly.

methods.name: str _filter_sdp_for_whatsapp(self, sdp: str)
methods.description: Filters SDP to contain only SHA-256 fingerprints for WhatsApp compatibility.

methods.name: SmallWebRTCConnection _handle_connect_event(self, call: WhatsAppConnectCall)
methods.description: Handles an incoming connect event by establishing a WebRTC connection, SDP exchange, and updating call state.

methods.name: bool _handle_terminate_event(self, call: WhatsAppTerminateCall)
methods.description: Handles call termination, disconnecting WebRTC and logging call details.
